newsitem.title: USA: World Bank lends $70 mln for Romanian schools.
newsitem.headline: World Bank lends $70 mln for Romanian schools.

text.p: The World Bank on Tuesday approved a $70 million loan to improve the safety of school buildings in rural Romania, the bank said in a statement.
"A critical challenge now in pre-university education is to tackle deteriorating school infrastructure," the bank said.
"The bank-assisted project will eliminate the physical risk to almost 200,000 students occupying damaged schools, 80 percent of which are in rural areas."

The bank said it was funding 66 percent of the cost of the project, which will improve facilities at 900 schools. The rest of the money would come from the Romanian government and the Council of Europe social development fund.
